inputs.title: Everyone suffocates when the host leaves even though the reactor is full
inputs.description: Playing with 3 friends, our host's internet dropped. Game said 'migrating host' and then kept going which was cool, BUT right after that all of us started losing oxygen super fast. The new host checked the reactor and it said full power and fuel was fine. Two of us died inside the base. If you go outside with a suit tank you're fine. Happened 3 times this week.

inputs.title: Save fails checksum after cryo-sleep autosave is interrupted by console suspend
inputs.description: Cryo pod sleep triggers a full autosave (CryoSerializer). If the console enters rest mode while the write is in flight (~1.5-3 s window during the fade), the save header is written with the new checksum but the world chunk block is truncated. On resume the load fails checksum validation. The rotating backup is also overwritten in the same pass because backup rotation happens before the write instead of after it, so there is no recoverable slot. Repro 6/10 on PS5 devkit, not reproducible on PC (no suspend). Severity critical: permanent progress loss.

inputs.title: we all died of no air after the host rage quit
inputs.description: lol so my friend rage quit after losing his rover and when the game moved the host to me everyone else's air went to 0 inside the hab. my air was fine. the reactor was ON and had fuel. had to tell everyone to put helmets on and go outside. pls fix

inputs.title: Joining from Nintendo friend list says session no longer available
inputs.description: If I go to my friend's profile on the Switch home menu and pick 'Join Game' it starts Starfall Outpost, sits on the connecting screen and then says 'Session no longer available (SO-4012)'. His lobby is definitely open and has room, he's waiting in it. Tried 5 times.

inputs.title: Quick Resume after sleeping in cryo pod destroyed my save
inputs.description: Went to bed in the cryo pod right as I switched to another game with Quick Resume. When I came back to Starfall the next day it went back to title screen and my outpost save says 'corrupted'. The backup is corrupted too. Pretty sure this is the same thing people on Reddit are posting about for PS5.

inputs.title: Hover-rover loses terrain collision on steep tiles in Ridge Canyon (sector C4)
inputs.description: The rover's hover raycasts query the simplified collision mesh, which has a gap on the C4 canyon slope (approx. world pos -2210, 85, 4402). On slopes above ~35 degrees the suspension force is zero for several frames and the vehicle falls through the render mesh into the kill volume. Cargo is destroyed with the vehicle. Repro 8/10, all platforms likely; tested on Xbox Series X.

inputs.title: Game becomes a slideshow in my farming base
inputs.description: I went all in on food production and built a giant greenhouse, now every time I walk in there the game drops to like 15 fps on my Series X. The rest of the map is smooth. Is there a limit on how many plants I should have??

inputs.title: Switch crashes if I undock while it's loading the Frozen Belt
inputs.description: Every time I pull the switch out of the dock while it's loading (like going to the Frozen Belt by shuttle) the whole game crashes and I get 'The software was closed because an error occurred'. Lost like 20 minutes of progress twice now.

inputs.title: Proximity VOIP stream drops for 4th player in 4-player session
inputs.description: In 4-player sessions, one client (not always the last joiner) stops receiving all VOIP streams. Outgoing voice still works. Reconnects after ~20 s, then drops again. Voice channel count appears hard-capped at 3 decoder instances per client; the 4th stream evicts one. Repro 9/10 on Series X with 4 consoles, also seen on PC.

inputs.title: Series S crashes after playing for a long time
inputs.description: Every time I play for a long session (like 5 hours, weekend vibes) my Series S just closes the game and goes to the dashboard. No error message. Shorter sessions are fine. My friend on Series X says it happens to him too but much later.

inputs.title: Picked 'keep local' and it loaded my 3 day old save!!!
inputs.description: Got the message about cloud save conflict, I clicked KEEP LOCAL because I knew my PS5 save was the newest. It loaded a save from 3 days ago instead and now that's my only save. Lost all my Deep Core progress and the Tier 2 reactor. Why is the button doing the opposite of what it says??

inputs.title: My Xbox buddy can never join my PS5 game
inputs.description: Me on PS5 and my mate on Xbox. When he hosts I can join fine. When I host and invite him through the Starfall friends list he gets 'Not permitted (SO-2207)'. We're friends in the game. My lobby is set to friends only because I don't want randoms.

inputs.title: Keep Local in cross-save prompt uploads stale cloud data (Steam Deck)
inputs.description: Additional repro of the cross-save prompt issue on Steam Deck (Proton): choosing 'Keep Local' triggers a download of the cloud slot followed by an upload of that same stale data; local save timestamp in the file browser goes backwards. Same root cause as the swapped button handlers.

inputs.title: Stuck in the tutorial, ARIA keeps telling me to go to the reactor
inputs.description: New player here, just bought it in the sale. I built the reactor because I saw it in the menu and now ARIA keeps saying 'head to the reactor site' and the objective won't finish. I'm standing right next to it. Restarted twice. Is there any way to skip the tutorial??

inputs.title: 8 player co-op is unplayable on PS5 when I host
inputs.description: Love the new mode but when I host with 8 people my PS5 stutters every few seconds, like a hard freeze for a split second. My friends say it's smooth for them. When my friend hosts on his PC it's fine.

inputs.title: Lightning ate my whole solar farm
inputs.description: Spent all evening building a solar farm, anchored everything AND built two lightning rods like the patch notes said. First storm, lightning just deleted half the panels. What's the point of the rods?

inputs.title: Saving icon stays on screen forever after cryo pod
inputs.description: After I wake up from the cryo pod the little spinning 'Saving...' icon in the bottom right corner never goes away. The save seems fine, I quit and reloaded and everything is there, but the icon stays until I reload. Kind of makes me nervous that it's not saving properly.

inputs.title: Oxygen drains after loading a save even though the reactor is full
inputs.description: Solo game, no co-op. When I load my save the oxygen reactor shows 100% output and fuel, but my oxygen meter inside the base keeps going down as if there's no reactor. If I turn the reactor off and on again it starts working. Started after Deep Core update.

inputs.title: Hover-rover bounces like crazy over base foundation edges
inputs.description: Whenever I drive the rover over the edge where my foundation meets the ground it starts bouncing up and down really violently, sometimes flips over. Not falling through anything, it just goes nuts. Only happens near my base, normal terrain is fine.

inputs.title: Client-side stutter when many players fire mining lasers at once
inputs.description: On PC clients, when 6+ players use mining lasers simultaneously, client frame time spikes to ~40 ms due to beam VFX spawning a new light per beam segment. Host is not affected differently from clients; this is a GPU cost, not replication.

inputs.title: Radio comms crackle with Bluetooth headset
inputs.description: When using my Bluetooth headset through the PS Link adapter, ARIA's radio voice lines and teammates' radio messages have a crackling/static sound. Game sound effects are clean. Wired headset doesn't have this.

inputs.title: Snap points not shown for storm shutters on curved hab walls
inputs.description: Storm shutter pieces show no snap points when aimed at curved habitat dome walls, so they can only be placed freehand and don't seal. Flat walls are fine. Not the old slope offset issue; the ghost is accurate but no sockets are offered.

inputs.title: Wind turbines produce zero power during storms
inputs.description: You'd think storms would be the best time for wind power, but my turbines go to 0 kW the moment a storm starts. They're not destroyed or damaged, they just stop spinning.

inputs.title: Foundations end up in the wrong spot when building on hills
inputs.description: Whenever I try to put down floor pieces on a hillside, the see-through preview shows one spot but the piece actually lands a bit to the side once I click. Flat ground works fine. Now none of my floors line up and there are gaps everywhere in my base.

inputs.title: Howling storm audio loops forever after the weather clears
inputs.description: QA note: once the first sandstorm event ends, the storm ambience bed continues to play indefinitely, including in sealed interiors. Only a return to the main menu clears it. Observed on PS5 retail build, 3/3 attempts.

inputs.title: Research node stays locked even though I meet every requirement
inputs.description: I've researched smelting and the advanced fabricator and have a pile of alloy plates in storage, but the welding tech in the research screen is still grey and nothing happens when I select it. Can't progress to the better hab walls.

inputs.title: Controller trigger stays heavy after putting the drill away
inputs.description: If I put my drill away while still holding the right trigger, the trigger on my DualSense keeps that heavy, clicky resistance for everything else, even driving. Opening and closing the pause menu makes it normal again.

inputs.title: Auto region sends me to servers on the other side of the world
inputs.description: I live in France and the automatic matchmaking keeps dropping me into Asia-Pacific lobbies with 300ms ping. Picking the EU region by hand works, so the auto option seems broken.

inputs.title: ORB-7 stops following me after passing through the airlock
inputs.description: My drone buddy flies into the airlock with me and then just sits jammed in the doorway. It won't follow me or pick up ore after that until I reload. Happens most times I go through an airlock.

inputs.title: Can't see anything in the frozen caves in portable mode
inputs.description: Playing undocked, the caves on the new ice moon are just black. My helmet torch only lights a tiny circle and I can't spot any crystals. When I put it back in the dock the caves are bright and blue.

inputs.title: Suit temperature readout ignores my metric setting
inputs.description: I set units to metric but the temperature display on my thermal suit HUD still shows Fahrenheit. The inventory tooltip shows Celsius correctly, so it's only the HUD.

inputs.title: Items get copied if host leaves while I'm taking stuff from a crate
inputs.description: Found a way to duplicate resources: if I'm pulling a stack out of a cargo crate right as the host quits and the game migrates host, the crate still has the stack afterwards and I also have it in my inventory.

inputs.title: Mining beam snaps to creatures instead of ore with aim assist
inputs.description: Using a gamepad on PC with aim assist turned on, the mining laser keeps locking onto nearby animals rather than the vein I'm pointing at. It's fine with aim assist off but then fighting is much harder.

inputs.title: Trade window closes when another player uses the same terminal
inputs.description: I was halfway through putting together an offer at the trading post and my friend walked up and used it too. My screen closed instantly and the offer I set up was gone.

inputs.title: Double storm after loading a mid-storm autosave
inputs.description: QA: Load an autosave that was written while a storm was active. After loading, two storms are active simultaneously and damage is doubled. Repro 4/4 on PC.

inputs.title: Photo mode hotkey cannot be rebound
inputs.description: In Settings > Controls, the photo mode key is missing from the keybinding list, so it is stuck on F12 which is also my Steam screenshot key. Every other action can be rebound.

inputs.title: Main menu music skips back to the start every few seconds
inputs.description: After returning to the main menu from a session, the title music restarts every 8-10 seconds instead of playing through. Restarting the game fixes it until I leave a session again.

inputs.title: Green checkerboard squares in the night sky on the ice moon
inputs.description: Docked mode on Switch: at night on the Frozen Belt the aurora effect turns into flickering green checkerboard blocks across the whole sky. Daytime looks normal. Started after the latest update.

inputs.title: Shared research points wiped when a second player leaves
inputs.description: In our 3-player outpost, when one of the guests leaves the session, all shared research points the group earned that evening are reset to zero for everyone, including the host. Personal research is untouched.

inputs.title: Steam Deck gyro aiming does nothing while driving
inputs.description: On Steam Deck the gyro aim works on foot but as soon as I get into a vehicle the gyro stops responding entirely, even when I use the vehicle's turret. Steam Input layout is the official one.

inputs.title: Save slot vanishes after renaming it with an emoji
inputs.description: I renamed my main save slot and included a star emoji in the name. The slot disappeared from the Load Game list right away and does not come back after restarting. The storage size still shows the data is there.

inputs.title: Everyone is disconnected when the host renames the outpost
inputs.description: If the host renames our outpost from the base management terminal while friends are connected, every client is kicked to the main menu with a connection lost message. The host keeps playing alone.

inputs.title: Towed cargo pods hover in mid-air after unhooking
inputs.description: When I unhook a cargo pod from the rover tow cable, it stays floating about two metres above the ground and cannot be picked up or pushed. Reloading the area drops it back to the ground.

inputs.title: Loading into my outpost takes over three minutes on Switch
inputs.description: Since the last patch, loading my save from the main menu takes three to four minutes on Switch. It used to take about forty seconds. My outpost is large but nothing changed in it.

inputs.title: Language filter in the lobby browser is ignored
inputs.description: Setting the lobby browser language filter to German still lists sessions in every language. The filter tick box stays checked but the results are the same as with no filter.
